main_text.p: Cap.4. trouerfiam. Etenim plus quàm diabolica effet confidentia, fi quis feipfum vellet Deo Præferre. Proponitur autem hic tota ratio veræ obedientiæ,quę doctrina vti liffima eft Exigitur pafsim obedientia, & neceffaria eft priuatim & publicè,in re do meftica,militari, Repub. Sed feré vtrinq; érratur, abijs quiiubent, & ijs qui obe- Vera impediunt,&c.Nota ¶1.Qui iubendi ius ha- randi ratiobent, ne quid iubeant quod Deo impro- quae?betur. Etfi enim hic aliquos alijs præfece- rit,fibi tamen in omnes ius feruat, & omnes fibi parere & feruire vult.Ideo D.Do minantium dicitur,Deut.10.1.Tim.6.&c. Apoc.19.Vir vxoris caput,fed cum ratio- ne,ne cogat ad impia.Eph.5. Parentü po- teftas magna in liberos, Deut.21. Sed habet hæc fuos limites,Deut.6.Pfal.78 Leuit.20.2.Reg.21.&c.Sic doctorum munus a Deo eft,Mal.2.Deut.17 2.Cor.5.Matt.16 Sed tunc ifta rata funt, fi Dei verbũ prædicent. Sic dictum prophetis, Ezech.3.33. Ier.1.Matth.28.Ita magiftratus Dij dicuntur,Exod 22.Pfal.82. Et his obediendum, Rom.13.Sed ijdem ferui Dei funt, quibus ille fua iudicia credidit,Deut.1.Pfalm.72. 2.Par.19. Illa ergo enuntient.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left are partly cut and damaged; the readings "Vera impe / randi ratio / quae?" and "Obedientiae / verae ratio." are doubtful. Final line is cut off at the page edge ("luntate" read as "luntate").
